routing_warnings.description: The reported failure concerns adherence to the script rather than whether a UGC video was produced.
The freelancer's disputed compliance claim and refusal to reshoot concern strict script adherence rather than the existence of the video deliverable.
The client reports that the delivery link cannot be opened, which concerns link accessibility rather than the delivery channel.
The freelancer claims that anyone with the link can view it, which concerns link accessibility.
The client specifies the maximum video duration rather than changing its delivery channel.
The client reports that the delivered video did not follow the script.
The client requests a reshoot with strict phrase adherence.
The client requests delivery in the project chat; this changes the delivery channel rather than establishing that a link is accessible.
The client again requests delivery through the project chat.
Posting another Drive link is delivery evidence but does not independently establish that the link was accessible.
